newsitem.title: UK: UK to retain quarterly issue of unemployment stats.
newsitem.headline: UK to retain quarterly issue of unemployment stats.

text.p: The British government said on Thursday that after wide-ranging consultations it had decided to continue with the current quarterly publication of employment and unemployment estimates from the Labour Force Survey (LFS).

Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said in a written parliamentary answer there was some support for monthly publication, but there were doubts whether the additional costs of seven to eight million pounds were justified.
"Accordingly ONS (the Office for National Statistics) will retain the current quarterly frequency of publication for the LFS," Clarke said.
But he said the government would seek to give greater prominence to the results from the existing quarterly survey. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 7768
